title: Seoul shares down 1.24% as Samsung disappoints on shareholder returns
caption:
Despite record earnings, Samsung Electronics stock dropped as investors were left waiting for updates on shareholder payouts. The KOSPI index reflected this uncertainty, closing lower on the day.
